# Semper Fit

> Semper Fit is the gym and the three covered padel courts at St. Christopher's International School, Karen, Nairobi, Kenya.

## Gym
- Classes: strength training, cardio, boxing, HIIT and group fitness
- Personal training, one to one with a Semper Fit trainer
- Membership: Ksh 11,000 for one school term, Ksh 30,000 for three terms (school holidays not included), Ksh 1,500 for a day pass
- Payment: M-Pesa Paybill 4122613, account "St. Christophers Holdings-GYM"
- Opening hours: Monday to Friday 5am-8am and 4pm-8pm, Saturday 6am-6pm, Sunday 10am-2pm

## Padel
- Three covered, glass-walled padel courts
- Court hire: Ksh 3,000 for 60 minutes, Ksh 4,000 for 90 minutes, for the whole court (up to four players)
- Open every day, 6am-9pm. Entrance through Gate 3a
- Lessons with a padel coach, club leagues, tournaments and private or company events
- Payment: M-Pesa Paybill 4122613, account "Padel"

## Contact
- Phone: 0720 720 444, WhatsApp 0742 822 357
- Email: semperfitgymnasium@scsinternational.sc.ke
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/semper_fit_gymnasium/
